source_assessment.A_missing_argument_mechanism: A assigns ${2:-} and attempts shift 2 without checking argument count. With only the option present, shift cannot consume two arguments; the script lacks errexit and the parsing loop can repeat without progress. This source mechanism is consistent with the retained timeouts.
source_assessment.B_missing_argument_mechanism: B checks available argument count before shifting and uses fail to emit a diagnostic and exit 1.
